headline: As of 2026-09-18: 5,963 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 3 of 50 states, D+51.8 registration lean.
bullets: 5,963 early/mail ballots cast so far across 3 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+51.8 by registration.
Most ballots cast: North Carolina (4,727), Pennsylvania (1,191), Florida (45).
